name: Steven DePaul
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Steven DePaul is an American television director and producer. He has directed multiple episodes of NCIS-LA, CSI-NY, GRIMM, The Unit, Bones, as well as many episodes of one hour dramatic television (updated list IMDB). He was a longstanding producer and director on NYPD Blue. In his capacity as producer of NYPD Blue he won the Emmy Award for Outstanding Drama Series in 1995 and the Best Television Drama Golden Globe Award in 1993. He was also nominated for this award for his work on NYPD Blue on five other occasions (in 1994, 1996, 1997, 1998 and 1999). He won a George F. Peabody for "Raging Bulls" (Season 6, episode 8), an episode he directed for NYPD Blue.
